Advice.description: A concrete, actionable recommendation derived from graph analysis.

x-docs.intent: Actionable output. Each advice maps to one concrete fix the developer can make.

SchemaGap.description: A mismatch between code and schema declarations.

type.description: missing = exported but not in registry. stale = in registry but not exported. no_xmethods = exported fn has no x-methods entry. stale_xmethod = x-methods entry but fn not found. param_mismatch = paramCount differs from schema.

detail.description: Extra context e.g. expected vs actual paramCount

x-docs.intent: Schema-code drift detection — exports, x-methods, and param signatures.

DuplicateInstantiation.description: A factory function instantiated independently in multiple files instead of being shared.

callers.description: Files that each independently instantiate this factory

x-docs.intent: Detects factories called independently in N≥2 files. Each call creates a separate instance — may indicate missing shared singleton.
